chapter.title: Partners
chapter.note: Rebuilt on 6 November 2026 from the PowerPyx 100% chart (41 nodes), the game’s own text (detroitbecometext template: 8 prompts, 25 options, 17 clues, 12 Hank arrows) and the Fandom wiki (chapter page, transcript, Relationship Stat). IN FRONT OF THE BAR → the talk (two of REASON, THREATEN, UNDERSTANDING, PERSIST) → SPILL HIS DRINK / BUY HIM ANOTHER DRINK / WAIT OUTSIDE → CONNOR AND HANK ARRIVE AT SCENE (PATIENT, FIRM, DIPLOMATIC) → [ CRIME SCENE ]: every clue under a timer, with HANK WANTS TO GO decided by the drink (refuses if spilled, accepts otherwise, then OUT OF TIME) → CONNOR KNOWS WHAT HAPPENED → REPORT TO LT. ANDERSON, a five-step reconstruction (three mistakes fail) → FOLLOW BLUE BLOOD TO ATTIC → SEARCH ATTIC → FOUND DEVIANT, or CRIME UNSOLVED. No probability, public-opinion, instability or Amanda change in the chapter (Amanda does not appear in Partners: operator, 2026-11-07). Cross-chapter: the deviant found (The Interrogation), the spilled drink (Waiting for Hank...), the writing, the rA9 shower and the statue (The Interrogation, Last Chance, Connor). Researched in docs/research/chapters/ch06-partners.md.

decisions.title: In front of the bar; face scans
decisions.context: Connor tracks Hank to Jimmy’s Bar, the fifth bar he tries. Patrons heckle him. He can face-scan the customers (optional) and must face-scan Lt. Anderson before talking to him.

options.label: Face scan customers
options.effect: Optional: the template’s ten Guests scans (name, birth date, job, criminal record).

options.label: Face scan Lt. Anderson
options.effect: Required; leads to the talk.

decisions.note: Chart nodes IN FRONT OF THE BAR (checkpoint), ENTER JIMMY’S BAR, FACE SCAN CUSTOMERS, FACE SCAN LT. ANDERSON.

benchmark.note: One decision: walk straight to Hank, or scan the patrons on the way (their nine scans become one fact). Hank’s scan is in both outcomes. If Connor died in The Hostage the situation notes the new serial number (52). No stat change.

decisions.title: Talk to Lt. Anderson
decisions.context: Hank tells the android to get lost. Connor answers twice from REASON, THREATEN, UNDERSTANDING and PERSIST.

options.label: REASON
options.effect: “Stop drinking and come with me.” No change.

options.label: THREATEN
options.effect: “I intend to file a report on your behavior.” Hank small down.

options.label: UNDERSTANDING
options.effect: “Some people are not comfortable in the presence of androids…” No change.

options.label: PERSIST
options.effect: “My instructions stipulate that I have to accompany you.” Hank small down.

decisions.note: Not a chart node. PowerPyx: two picks before the drink choice.

benchmark.note: Two decision scenes; the second drops the line already said. THREATEN and PERSIST −1 Hank each, from the template’s arrows.

decisions.title: Spill his drink, buy him another, or wait outside
decisions.context: The chart’s three-way choice. Hank always comes to the scene; the drink decides later whether he grants extra time.

options.label: SPILL HIS DRINK
options.effect: Hank large down; cross-chapter: Hank refuses extra time later; LAST NIGHT in Waiting for Hank...

options.label: BUY HIM ANOTHER DRINK
options.effect: Hank large up; he grants extra time and Connor reminds him of the drink. PARTNERS trophy route.

options.label: WAIT OUTSIDE
options.effect: No change; he grants extra time.

decisions.note: Chart nodes BUY HIM ANOTHER DRINK, WAIT OUTSIDE, SPILL HANK’S DRINK (yellow padlock). Template button: SPILL HIS DRINK.

benchmark.note: Options in the game’s order with the template’s arrows at the sizes the operator measured (2026-11-07, two replays, level read in the chart header): SPILL −3, BUY +2, WAIT 0. Story 1.9.2 had SPILL −2. Stored as ch06Drink.

decisions.title: Connor and Hank arrive at scene; the car
decisions.context: Hank: “You wait here. I won’t be long.” Connor answers, then follows him anyway.

options.label: PATIENT
options.effect: “Whatever you say, Lieutenant.” Hank small up.

options.label: FIRM
options.effect: “No way! I’m coming with you.” Hank small down; Hank’s “stay in the car” reprimand is skipped.

options.label: DIPLOMATIC
options.effect: “My instructions are to accompany you…” Hank small up.

decisions.note: Checkpoint CONNOR AND HANK ARRIVE AT SCENE; the car prompt is not a chart node.

benchmark.note: The template’s arrows: +1, −1, +1. FIRM is stored (ch06Firm).

decisions.title: Briefing and the crime scene search
decisions.context: Officer Ben Collins briefs Hank: Carlos Ortiz, about three weeks dead, a record for theft and aggravated assault, a missing android, no break-in. Connor then searches the house under a roughly five-minute timer, reviewing ten pieces of evidence.

options.label: ANALYZE CARLOS’ BODY / RECONSTRUCT CARLOS’ LAST MOMENTS
options.effect: Four body clues, then the first reconstruction: they came from the kitchen.

options.label: ANALYZE KNIFE, ANALYZE RED ICE, blood at marker 4, ANALYZE BLOOD ON WALLS (5, 6)
options.effect: Evidence in the living room and hallway.

options.label: EXAMINE CHAIR, ANALYZE MISSING KNIFE, ANALYZE BASEBALL BAT / RECONSTRUCT ASSAULT WITH BAT
options.effect: The kitchen: the struggle, the missing knife, the beating.

options.label: EXAMINE EDEN CLUB FLYER, ANALYZE BACKYARD
options.effect: The flyer; the backyard shows the deviant did not leave that way. Not evidence: the transcript prints no REVIEW EVIDENCE counter under them.

options.label: INVESTIGATE WRITING, SAMPLE BLOOD, OPEN CLOSET
options.effect: I AM ALIVE in CyberLife Sans; tasting the blood (Hank is disgusted); nothing in the closet.

options.label: CHECK SHOWER, EXAMINE STATUE
options.effect: rA9 written over the shower walls; the statuette, a religious offering. Cross-chapter: The Interrogation, Last Chance, Connor.

options.label: READ “ANDROID SEX”, READ “ANDROID SPY”
options.effect: The two kitchen magazines; no stat effect.

options.label: CONNOR KNOWS WHAT HAPPENED
options.effect: REVIEW EVIDENCE 10/10: report to Hank.

options.label: HANK WANTS TO GO
options.effect: Time ran out first.

decisions.note: Every node in the chart’s CRIME SCENE bracket. The ten pieces of evidence are the transcript’s REVIEW EVIDENCE n/10 items: the reconstruction, knife, red ice, three blood marks, the bathroom (at the statue), chair, knife rack and the bat reconstruction; not the flyer or the backyard (PowerPyx lists eleven).

benchmark.note: The briefing is an event. The search is one repeatable scene: every bracket node is an option, one per visit; examined items disappear. Complete at all ten of the transcript’s evidence items, the statue among them (story 1.9.1 used ten of PowerPyx’s eleven). The timer is an action budget (13 actions, then 5 more if Hank accepts; unsourced counts); it stops once Connor knows what happened. Hank’s idle moves (closet, flyer, red ice, kitchen) appear as the clock runs. The magazines are options here, not a media scene. No stat change.

decisions.title: Hank wants to go: refuses or accepts
decisions.context: If the investigation is not finished in time Hank heads for the door; Connor asks for five more minutes.

options.label: HANK REFUSES (drink spilled)
options.effect: “You spill a man’s drink… Fuck you.” Hank small down; HANK ENDS INVESTIGATION; crime unsolved.

options.label: HANK ACCEPTS (drink bought or waited)
options.effect: “Five minutes.” If the extra time also runs out: OUT OF TIME, Hank small down, crime unsolved.

decisions.gate: Only when the search runs out of time.
decisions.note: Chart nodes HANK WANTS TO GO, ASK FOR MORE TIME, HANK REFUSES, HANK ACCEPTS, HANK ENDS INVESTIGATION, OUT OF TIME. The template decides by the drink (the wiki agrees; PowerPyx says “at least Tense”).

benchmark.note: Four event scenes. C05t cuts into the search; C05x returns to it for five more actions; C05y and C05z each apply the template’s one Hank small down.

decisions.title: Report to Lt. Anderson: reconstruct the crime
decisions.context: Connor walks Hank through the crime in five steps: it started in the kitchen, the victim attacked the android with the bat, the android stabbed him, he fled to the living room, the android killed him with the knife.

options.label: RECONSTRUCT THE CRIME
options.effect: All five right: Hank small up once, on the thirium trail (operator: one arrow, not the template’s two).

options.label: FAIL TO RECONSTRUCT THE CRIME
options.effect: Three wrong answers: “I’ve just hit my bullshit quota for the evening.” Hank small down; crime unsolved.

decisions.note: Template note: “After three mistakes, he will leave.” A wrong first answer only makes Hank point to the kitchen.

benchmark.note: One repeatable decision scene: the template’s five prompts in order, the game’s three button labels each, rotated deterministically per question with IDs remapped to positions (correct positions 1, 3, 2, 1, 3) to remove the always-first cue; a wrong answer repeats the question with Hank’s line; the third mistake in all fails. Story 1.9.8: when a question repeats after a wrong answer, the wrong button already picked is no longer offered (three buttons, then two); scene field hideWrongPicked, older snapshots offer all three (video frame, gZQ693-umPU 27:56).

decisions.title: Follow blue blood to the attic; search attic
decisions.context: The android was damaged by the bat and lost thirium. Connor follows the trail to the end of the hall, sees where a ladder used to be, takes the kitchen chair and climbs into the attic.

options.label: FOLLOW BLUE BLOOD TO ATTIC
options.effect: Scripted.

options.label: SEARCH ATTIC
options.effect: Scripted (the hatch prompt repeats until it works).

decisions.note: Chart nodes FOLLOW BLUE BLOOD TO ATTIC and SEARCH ATTIC.

benchmark.note: Two event scenes, no stat change.

decisions.title: Find the hidden suspect
decisions.context: The chapter’s two endings: FOUND DEVIANT (the android in the attic begs Connor not to tell; Connor calls Hank regardless) or CRIME UNSOLVED (Hank refused more time, the extra time ran out, or the reconstruction failed).

options.label: FOUND DEVIANT
options.effect: The Interrogation becomes available; the statue (if examined) can later serve in Last Chance, Connor.

options.label: CRIME UNSOLVED
options.effect: No interrogation; Amanda large down at the start of Waiting for Hank...; with a spilled drink, Connor can apologize (LAST NIGHT).

decisions.gate: Reach the end of the chapter.
decisions.note: Chart endings FOUND DEVIANT (yellow padlock) and CRIME UNSOLVED. No button to keep quiet about the android.

benchmark.note: Two event scenes. FOUND DEVIANT sets suspect, suspectAlive and ch06DeviantFound; no Hank arrow (the template has none and the operator saw none; the chapter page’s “Finding the deviant” up is unobserved, not applied). CRIME UNSOLVED applies nothing itself; the Amanda large down belongs to Waiting for Hank...
